patterns.note: Heavy reliance on a recurring D-shape (semi-circle) motif, used both as delicate outline containers for text and as solid, vibrant color blocks in grids.
High-contrast typography featuring oversized, tightly-tracked geometric sans-serif headings paired with small, clean body copy and occasional monospaced labels.
High-contrast dark-mode base punctuated by stark white sections, accented with a vibrant coral-pink primary brand color and soft pastel secondary tones.
Smooth transitions between dark and light sections on scroll, with subtle ambient video backgrounds in the hero and interactive hover states on accordion blocks.
A modular grid layout for insights/articles using soft, multi-colored pastel backgrounds to differentiate content cards visually.

technique_notes: Recreate the signature D-shape containers using CSS border-radius properties applied to specific corners (e.g., top-right and bottom-right set to 50% of width) to form perfect semi-circles, maintaining responsiveness.

Implement a high-contrast theme-switching layout that alternates between deep black and pure white sections, using smooth CSS transitions or scroll-triggered class toggles to shift the background fluidly.
Build the interactive accordion grid ('Many paths. One shared momentum') where clicking or hovering on a category smoothly expands the container to reveal nested content while rotating the plus icon.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, ultra-bold display headings with tight letter-spacing contrasted against small, highly readable body text and tiny uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Varies dramatically: sharp 90-degree corners on standard grids, mixed with perfectly rounded semi-circular (D-shape) edges on thematic cards and pill-shaped CTA buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and editorial, utilizing generous vertical padding between major sections to let the bold typography and geometric shapes breathe.

standout: The distinctive use of the 'D-shape' (semi-circle) as a core visual anchor—appearing as delicate outlines, solid color blocks, and structural framing—creates a highly memorable brand identity that elevates it above standard grid-based layouts.
